Below 30 she says she will not talk against her own bank to a stranger

setting: the raft and the well, each keeper at their own bank

Signs-For-The-Cargo agrees first or second; his agreement answers Livia's second objection. A refused attempt names the open objection, the journal keeps it, and Livia's refusal opens topic.lf83-stop-charge
